prediction_text: 断：沃勒（议会军）胜，霍普顿败。沃勒方月亮擢升合木星、疾行增光，太阳居十宫且正落在19°白羊擢升度数，主其军势与助力俱在顶点；霍普顿主星土星入弱、无容纳、无相位且伏日下，又无后援接应（九宫只有火星与南交点）。胜负当日见分晓，即1644年3月29日交战当日。
timing_claim: on the day of engagement, 29 March 1644 (day scale)
basis: Waller: Asc/Moon/Jupiter/Venus; Moon exalted with Jupiter, swift and increasing; Sun lord of his substance in 10th in exact exaltation degree 19 Aries. Hopton: Saturn lord 7th sub radiis, in fall, peregrine, no aspect; only Mars+South Node in his 9th = no supplies ready.
